name: Disguise via Pseudo-Linear Scheduling
description: The problem is framed as assigning priority tiers to background tasks, which typically suggests a greedy or topological sort algorithm. The adjacency constraint (3-coloring) is obfuscated using a modular arithmetic condition ($4 s_u + s_v \not\equiv 0 \pmod 5$) that perfectly maps to $s_u \neq s_v$ over the domain {1,2,3}. Models that rely on surface pattern matching will likely fail by writing a greedy/DP algorithm, while models that genuinely reason will deduce the equivalence to 3-coloring and write the correct backtracking search.
